database.transaction_contract: db.transaction() -> contextmanager Connection; commits normal exit, rolls back exceptions. Services MUST accept the same Connection and never independently commit. No automatic observers; domain owner must orchestrate source side effects. Auth abuse quota/captcha transactions are deliberately independent. DDL auto-commits, init-db refuses nonempty DB. UTC database session.
